name: Oppressor-9 class dark trooper
description: The Oppressor-9 class dark trooper was a dark trooper variant used by the Galactic Empire. It was similar to the Oppressor-7 class dark trooper in that its duties were virtually the same, although it could both inflict and absorb more damage.

data.name: Oppressor-9 class dark trooper
data.armament: Virtually any rifle wielded by humanoids
